question.wording: Did the taxpayer request an early refund of the withholding shown in Form 8288-A box 4?

options.label: Yes — an early refund was requested

default.because: No early refund was requested unless a preparer says so

citation.wording: To receive credit for any federal income tax withheld shown in box 4, attach Form 8288-A to your tax return, unless you make a request for early refund.
